description: Bike Routes is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Adelaide. Displays the bicycle routes located in the Adelaide City Council area. Information provided includes the primary bicycle network, important secondary roads and secondary (alternate) routes. Co-ordinate System: Geographic Coordinate System: GCSWGS1984. Datum: DWGS1984. Prime Meridian: Greenwich. Angular Unit: Degree. Coverage: City of Adelaide. The portal files it under the publisher City of Adelaide. Its tags are bikes, council, health, nature, network. It offers 2 resource(s) in KMZ, PDF. The portal shows 2025-08-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
